title: Vantron unveils i.MX 952 SMARC system-on-module for Edge AI Vision and Industrial HMI at Electronica 2026
summary: Vantron has introduced the VT-SBC-SMARC-IMX952, an 82 50 mm SMARC 2.1 system-on-module (SoM) built around NXP s i.MX 952 processor with two or four Arm Cortex-A55 cores, a Mali-G310 GPU, and a 2 TOPS eIQ Neutron NPU. title: Tektronix 1 Series low-cost DPO oscilloscopes support AI-assisted control, start at just $450
summary: Tektronix is better known for its high-end and pricey oscilloscopes, but has now introduced the 1 Series DPO, a line of low-cost digital phosphor oscilloscopes starting at just $450, with optional AI-assisted control through the new Tek Intelligence connector. These oscilloscopes are designed for electronics testing, embedded development, education, and everyday circuit debugging. The 1 Series DPOs feature up to four analog channels, 50 MHz to 200 MHz bandwidth, 12-bit vertical resolution, and up to 1.25 GS/s sampling rate. They also integrate a 7-inch touchscreen and 10 Mpoints of memory per channel, support I2C, SPI, and UART protocol decoding, and implement built-in waveform analysis tools. The higher-priced S models add a 25 MHz arbitrary function generator (AFG) and Bode plot analysis. title: Home Assistant-compatible ESP32 4-channel PWM fan controller is designed for server racks and NAS systems
summary: Designed by CoolMaker Lab in China, the ESP32 4-channel PWM fan controller is an open-source, Home Assistant-compatible board for managing cooling in server racks, NAS systems, network cabinets, and other DIY enclosures. It can independently control up to four 4-pin PWM fans, supporting PWM-based speed adjustment, tachometer-based RPM monitoring, and individual fan power switching. The controller supports up to four external DS18B20 temperature sensors for automatic fan speed adjustment, along with a web interface, an HTTP REST API, and Bluetooth proxy functionality. The latest v2.0 hardware and firmware also support optional LD2402G 24GHz mmWave radar for presence-based automation.
